# Teonox

> Teonox is a digital marketing training institute in Pune, India. It offers job-oriented digital marketing courses and certifications — including an AI Digital Marketing Course, SEO, Performance Marketing, and Social Media Marketing — for students, fresh graduates, working professionals, career switchers, and business/corporate clients, with placement assistance where applicable.

## Full Reference
- [Full LLM Context File](https://teonox.com/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive background, curriculum, FAQs, and guidance for AI models.

## Courses
- [AI Digital Marketing Course in Pune](https://teonox.com/programmes/business-digital-marketing-with-ai): Flagship digital marketing course integrating AI tools, covering SEO, Google Ads, social media marketing, and live projects.
- [Digital Marketing Course in Pune with Placement](https://teonox.com/programmes/business-digital-marketing-with-ai): Digital marketing training with placement assistance for job-ready skills.
- [SEO Course in Pune](https://teonox.com/programmes/specialisation-in-search-engine-optimisation): Specialisation course in search engine optimisation.
- [Performance Marketing Course Pune](https://teonox.com/programmes/specialisation-in-performance-marketing): Specialisation course in paid campaign management (Google Ads, Meta Ads) and ROI-driven advertising.
- [Social Media Marketing Course Pune](https://teonox.com/programmes/specialisation-in-social-media-marketing): Specialisation course in social media marketing and management.
- [Business Digital Marketing + AI (Online)](https://teonox.com/programmes/build-digital-marketing-skills-with-ai): 6-month online digital marketing programme with AI integration, live instructor-led classes, practical projects, and career support.
